description: This file implements functions for managing a set of object IDs (oids) in a Git-related project. It includes functions for initializing, inserting, checking containment, comparing, removing, and parsing object IDs from a file.

methods.name: void oidset_init(struct oidset * set,size_t initial_size)
methods.description: Initializes an object ID set with a specified initial size.

methods.name: int oidset_contains(const struct oidset * set,const struct object_id * oid)
methods.description: Checks if a specific object ID exists within the set.

methods.name: bool oidset_equal(const struct oidset * a,const struct oidset * b)
methods.description: Compares two object ID sets for equality.

methods.name: int oidset_insert(struct oidset * set,const struct object_id * oid)
methods.description: Inserts an object ID into the set.

methods.name: void oidset_insert_from_set(struct oidset * dest,struct oidset * src)
methods.description: Inserts all object IDs from a source set into a destination set.

methods.name: int oidset_remove(struct oidset * set,const struct object_id * oid)
methods.description: Removes a specified object ID from the set.

methods.name: void oidset_clear(struct oidset * set)
methods.description: Clears all object IDs from the set, re-initializing it.

methods.name: void oidset_parse_file(struct oidset * set,const char * path,const struct git_hash_algo * algop)
methods.description: Parses a file containing object IDs and populates the set.

methods.name: void oidset_parse_file_carefully(struct oidset * set,const char * path,const struct git_hash_algo * algop,oidset_parse_tweak_fn fn,void * cbdata)
methods.description: Parses a file containing object IDs with careful handling of comments and whitespace.

ctags.name: oidset_contains
ctags.pattern: /^int oidset_contains(const struct oidset *set, const struct object_id *oid)$/
ctags.signature: (const struct oidset * set,const struct object_id * oid)

ctags.pattern: /^bool oidset_equal(const struct oidset *a, const struct oidset *b)$/
ctags.signature: (const struct oidset * a,const struct oidset * b)

ctags.name: oidset_parse_file
ctags.signature: (struct oidset * set,const char * path,const struct git_hash_algo * algop)

ctags.name: oidset_parse_file_carefully
ctags.signature: (struct oidset * set,const char * path,const struct git_hash_algo * algop,oidset_parse_tweak_fn fn,void * cbdata)
